title: Couple Posing Outdoors, 1940s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s outdoor portrait featuring a well-dressed couple posing closely together next to a young tree in a suburban or rural lawn setting. The woman is wearing a patterned A-line button-front dress and heels, while the man stands beside her in a dark double-breasted suit and striped tie. A building in the background displays a faint sign reading Dreamland Caramels, adding a touch of period commercial history to the scene.
